thread:
maria_acct_exec: Heads upprospect is a regulated payments provider. RFP calls for BYO-HSM support + auditable key rotation SLA. Can we put together SOW bullets + price delta by EOD?
leo_se: Can you paste the RFP snippets? will triage gaps.
maria_acct_exec: Pasted: 
- Customer-supplied HSM allowed (PKCS#11) or vendor-managed HSM option
- Key import via wrapped blobs or onsite key ceremony
- Monthly rotation window: 01:00-03:00 local TZ, require <0.1% downtime outside window
- Need attestation artifacts (HSM vendor cert, firmware hash list, serials) and an operations runbook
- Escrow/export: physical export option with chain-of-custody
- Pricing: show delta for managed HSM vs proxy-only + per-op premium for HSM ops
carmen_crypto: Quick notes: we support PKCS#11 and cloud-HSM connectors. For customer-supplied appliances we run a connector in their VPC that keeps unwrapped keys only inside the appliance boundary. No plaintext in our control plane.
leo_se: Important for them: low-latency crypto calls (they quoted 200 qps burst). We should recommend sticky connections to the connector and a small local LRU cache for AEAD keys.
oliver_ops: Cache note: we can do a TTL-based KV cache with safe key-swap semantics: stage -> switch pointer -> gc. That avoids mass cache invalidation. Rotation within a 2-hour window is fine if we do zero-downtime pointer switch.
amy_fin: Pricing ask: do we charge for HSM hours + per-op premium + a managed-node monthly fee? what about escrow labor for physical export?
carmen_crypto: Pricing model we typically show: (1) managed HSM instance hourly + (2) per-crypto-op surcharge (percentage over baseline per-token rate) + (3) SOW line for escrow/ceremony (fixed day-rate). I'll draft numbers with assumptions.
maria_acct_exec: Legal flagged one blocker: they want confirmation keys never leave their HSM in unwrapped form and that audit logs show key usage but not key material.
legal_bot: Automated note: please provide security questionnaire snippet for Q5.3 (key handling). See template: s3://redwood/legal/templates/sec-qna-Q5.3.pdf
carmen_crypto: Draft snippet: "Redwood does not persist unwrapped customer key material in the control plane. Wrapped key blobs are transferred and only unwrapped inside the customer's HSM connector or the vendor-managed HSM appliance. Audit/logging captures key identifiers and operation metadata; key material is never exported in plaintext."
leo_se: They also asked for an example import command. Use this sample (PKCS#11 wrapped blob):
```
# example: import wrapped key via sftp then import into HSM connector
sftp> put wrapped_key.blob /incoming/
ssh connector$ sudo kmsctl import --wrapped /incoming/wrapped_key.blob --label "cust-prod-1"
```
oliver_ops: Ops checklist we need to hand to them: network IP allowlist, mTLS certs for connector, maintenance SLA, escalation contacts. Add a note on maintenance window: we cannot promise global node restarts; must be single-plane rolling.
amy_fin: I'll prepare a delta table: monthly managed-HSM baseline + expected per-op uplift at 200 qps. Need connector count estimate (2 connectors recommended for HA).
maria_acct_exec: Also they requested attestation artifacts example. Can someone attach an example attestation PEM and a manifest?
carmen_crypto: Uploading sample: s3://internal/kms/attestation/samples/hsm_attest_example.pem (will attach in thread). Also manifest sample: s3://internal/kms/attestation/samples/firmware_manifest.txt
invoice-bot: Automated: generated quote draft #Q-9472 (private link) -> https://billing.internal/quotes/Q-9472 :invoice: 
leo_se: Two technical clarifications I want on the SOW: 1) who owns firmware patching for customer-supplied HSMs? 2) rollback/rollback window for failed rotations?
carmen_crypto: Answer: (1) customer typically owns firmware patching for their appliance unless they opt for vendor-managed HSM (we can offer patching as add-on). (2) rotations are atomic pointer swaps; we keep previous key for TTL period (configurable) to enable quick rollback.
maria_acct_exec: Ok please get SOW bullets + pricing delta + small network PNG to procurement by EOD PST. They need it for vendor review Monday. :pray: 
amy_fin: Will do. I'll attach the preliminary cost sheet and line items later today.
leo_se: I'll convert the ASCII diagram to PNG and attach.
carmen_crypto: I'll finalize the attestation explanation + import checklist tomorrow morning.
maria_acct_exec: Thanks team. small follow-up: include a one-paragraph security statement for legal cert. Keep it short and precise.
carmen_crypto: Draft final line: "Redwood's architecture and procedures ensure that customer key material remains under the customer's control: wrapped transports, in-HSM unwrapping, and no plaintext persistence in Redwood control plane. Attestations and manifests are provided per-request for audit"
maria_acct_exec: Perfect. I'll stitch everything and send. :thumbsup:
